# Dependency pins applied on top of the pinned envoyproxy/ratelimit commit
# (ENVOY_RATELIMIT_VERSION) to remediate CVEs in the bundled image.
#
# Each entry is a minimum version. `go mod tidy` settles the rest, so modules
# that move only as a consequence -- x/sys and x/text here -- are not listed.
#
# golang.org/x/net v0.56.0 clears CVE-2026-33814, an HTTP/2 SETTINGS infinite
# loop fixed in v0.53.0. Pinned above the fix to match calico's own modules.
golang.org/x/net v0.56.0
